---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for Isleta
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe what you'd like the island to do.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternatives?

## Use Case
How would you use this day to day?

## Additional Context
Any other context, mockups, or screenshots.

## Area
Which part of Isleta would this touch?
- [ ] Now Playing
- [ ] Volume / mute HUD
- [ ] Notifications
- [ ] Shelf
- [ ] Welcome Back
- [ ] Island behaviour (peek, expand, queue, gestures)
- [ ] Settings
- [ ] Displays / multi-monitor
- [ ] Permissions
- [ ] Something new
